source_text:
ἐκ προσώ-που τοῦ Θεοῦ λαλεῖ· καὶ ἐὰν προσωποποιήσῃ τὸν Χριστὸν, οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ
Χριστὸς ὁ λαλῶν, ἀλλὰ τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον ἐκ προσώπου τοῦ Χριστοῦ λαλεῖ. Οὕτω,
pass_a_gloss: …speaks from the person of God; and if it should personify Christ, it is not Christ who is speaking, but the Holy Spirit speaks from the person of Christ. Thus,
pass_b_english: …speaks from the person of God; and if the Spirit personifies Christ, it is not Christ who is speaking, but the Holy Spirit speaking from Christ's person. So…

choices.choice: person of God / of Christ = speaking-role, not modern psychological person.
